name: archon-panel
description: An Archon pane in the side panel: this project's workflow runs, their graphs and logs, and the approvals that wait on you.

archonPath.title: Archon command
archonPath.description: The Archon CLI to run. Empty finds it on your PATH or in ~/.archon/bin.

archonPort.title: Archon server port
archonPort.description: Where archon serve answers on this machine (1-65535). Runs come from the CLI when nothing answers.

archonLog.title: Archon's log file
archonLog.description: The file archon serve writes to, shown in the Archon's log sub-tab.

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: Which run events raise a toast: all of them, only runs that need you, or none.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show live runs and runs that need you under the prompt.
